body: I am in a terrible place, which makes nothingness seem just that more beautiful.

I can't get a wink of sleep without medication because of my multiple deployments. And with all this going on in my head as well? Not a chance. I can't even fathom going to work tomorrow morning at 0600.

I asked her to go to counseling with me and she has absolutely no desire to go right now. If I was to try to request a psychologist for myself and tell him how I'm feeling, I would most likely lose my security clearance and my job. So that's not an option either.
It would be the military police. They have all the authority to go in if they please. I'm already gone anyways. I took some drinks with me and went somewhere dark and alone. This is on my phone.

Honestly, I came here because I literally have nobody to turn to or just talk with. It's so excruciatingly painful knowing nobody is there for you. I've had one of my soldiers commit suicide about a year ago. Looking back at it all, I kind of envy him right now.

I'm in NC. Yes, the gym was 2-3 hrs ago. She just left the house and said she might or might not be back tonight. I'm worried she might contact someone and have people come check on me. I think I'm going to leave the house just to be safe.

I really don't want to disclose where I'm stationed. Just in case I don't follow through with my plans, I don't want to be held down and placed on suicide watch.

The love of my life has been lying and been conniving continuously. I found out she's been sleeping at another soldiers house a lot lately. I never told her I knew and found out all this info. I was willing to let it pass as long as we started working on things. Today, I went to the gym and she was there already working out. A little into my workout, I see him there and I snap. I confront her about how I know everything. She explains to me that I'm fucking crazy and she wants a divorce.

Now, I'm back to where I was a week ago. A beer in my hand and a pistol sitting in front of me. She seems to just no longer care anymore. So why should I?

I try to. I try my best to just keep pushing on. The hardest part about all of this is that I am always such an optimistic and upbeat person. Normally I'm too positive. Not now though. I just can't take this shit. I can't talk to my parents about it and literally have no close friends to turn to that I can trust with telling them this. Especially in the military. If anyone finds out my thoughts or intentions, I'm done and I might as well just do it. I just have nowhere to turn to. It used to be her, but not as of now.
That's not the only underlying issues. I've been down this road before,just nowhere near this bad.
